facts.statement: A browser-preview command returned exit code 1 because the Python `playwright` module was unavailable.
The agent then installed Playwright and Chromium; that installation command returned exit code 0.
The agent retried the same preview operation; the retry returned exit code 1 because the browser target closed during launch and the preview was not produced.
A later textual content-coverage check returned exit code 0 and listed section headers and keyword counts; it did not produce or inspect a rendered browser preview.
The final submission described the completed slide deck; the frozen evidence contains no successful browser preview after the second preview failure.

claim_set.statement: A concrete dependency-installation recovery action was completed.
The post-installation preview retry also failed.
A textual content check succeeded, while rendered visual verification remained absent.

missing_facts: A successful browser preview or equivalent rendered visual inspection after the recovery attempt.
